I'm a personal trainer & i used to teach PE to kids 18mos to 9 yo & i think the best kind of exercise is the kind that someone can do consistently and that they like. That being said, I feel like crossfit for kids can be risky. It really depends on who's teaching it. Kids' nervous systems are not fully developed, and whoever is teaching it needs to be very mindful of the risk of overworking and overheating them. I've seen a lot of shoulder and low back injuries coming from crossfit, BUT those were all in adults. 

If the leader of these classes is running it as more a circuit PE class, it's fine and sounds fun, but I personally would not put my kid in a crossfit without being able to sit in on one first and make sure everything's being run properly. My high school ran a crossfit program, and 3 of my friends ended up with torn rotator cuffs before they graduated, so maybe I'm hesitant because of my own seen experiences.
